declarations.rationale: Auction-house/gallery/salesroom and headquarters physical locations dominate the dictionary.
Inverse minister-of and possessed-minister paths dominate.
Replace, predecessor, take-place and succeeded-person paths form the dominant family.
Corporate agency-part and unit-of constructions dominate.
Campus-in and geographically modified campus paths dominate, with headquarters/city location context.
Explicit official title paths dominate; nearby officer/specialist/secretary roles are checked against the shared official scope.
Public attorney title and attorney-tenure constructions dominate.
Director-of and historical serving/resignation/name-as-director constructions dominate.
Division-of and corporate-unit paths form the largest coherent family (five rows), ahead of sporting opposition (four) and local professional practice.
Explicit manager title paths dominate; spokesperson and sporting-title paths are separate meanings.
Inverse spokesperson briefing/speech constructions form the dominant coherent family.
Retain-control, control-of and political win paths form the largest family, ahead of corporate containment.
Inverse minister office paths dominate.

Be-in plus location speech/relative residence form a physical-presence family; the highest-frequency individual path is be-in (five), ahead of spokesperson (four). Institution-versus-place remains case-specific.
Explicit coach title paths dominate.
Institutional admission/entry paths dominate, separate from sporting victory and competition.
Explicit membership/service and organizational office constructions dominate; ally is separate and insufficient by itself.
President-of, presidential tenure and past-president roles dominate.
Played-in, lost-in and beaten-in event constructions dominate.
Geographic city-to-office-of paths form the largest coherent family, alongside city-attached director/analyst roles whose office location may be unclear.
Founder-of paths dominate, distinct from executive/merger context.

No broad majority family. HQ-in-town is the only repeated individual path (two rows), resolving ties among smaller location, management and competition families under the predeclared highest-path tie-break. Weak signal explicitly retained; unrelated meanings are not absorbed.
Support-for/of totals six rows, ahead of send-to five; generic transfers are not equated with support.
Explicit wife appositive/accompaniment family totals seven rows, ahead of corporate management six.
